name: Data.lineMultiplier_integral_and_small
summary: Write y as a double class sum of conjugated products of three theta kernels (carrier class sum, the negative definite constant, the L⁺ kernel of the cleared coordinates H·linePolyCoords); exists_modKernel_integral_bound for the three pairs gives the constant c, the p-integrality of each factor (with the points made integral above p) and, when Q_ϑ = ∅ (then N(Q_ϑ) = 1, as the conjugate bounds of exists_modKernel_integral_bound need q = 1), the conjugate bounds, which the scales absorb into exp(rB₀).

steps.claim: (Part of the statement: it contains `let y := …`, and the line census of the checker takes that := for the declaration's, so these lines count as the value.) The two properties (i) and (ii) of y.
steps.lean:
lemma Data.lineMultiplier_integral_and_small : ∃ c ≠ (0 : ℂ), ∀ i ϑ h, let y := star (c •
    lineMultiplier ϑ j i h); (∀ p [Fact p.Prime] [PadicPlace p], p.Coprime ϑ.levelNorm →
    weylGauge _ 0 h y ≤ 1) ∧ (ϑ.Q = ∅ → ∀ φ : ℂ ≃+* ℂ, weylNormSq (φ ∘ y) ≤ .exp (D.r * D.B₀)) := by
